questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT a property of bitmap graphics?

options.A: Fast hardware exists to move blocks of pixels efficiently.
options.B: Realistic lighting and shading can be done.
options.C: All line segments can be displayed as straight.
options.D: Polygons can be filled with solid colors and textures.

questions.answer_explanation: The statement is correct because bitmap graphics represent images as a grid of individual pixels, making it impossible to represent curved lines or diagonal segments without them appearing jagged or pixelated, thus all line segments cannot be displayed as perfectly straight.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following statements is FALSE about memory reclamation based on reference
counting?

options.A: Reference counting is well suited for reclaiming cyclic structures.
options.B: Reference counting incurs additional space overhead for each memory cell.
options.C: Reference counting is an alternative to mark-and-sweep garbage collection.
options.D: Reference counting need not keep track of which cells point to other cells.

questions.answer_explanation: Reference counting cannot effectively reclaim cyclic structures because the presence of mutual references between objects prevents their reference counts from ever reaching zero, leading to memory leaks.

Which of the following instruction-set features is NOT generally considered an obstacle to
aggressive pipelining of an integer unit?

options.A: Condition codes set by every instruction
options.C: Instructions requiring widely varying numbers of cycles to execute

questions.answer_explanation: The presence of several different classes of registers can enhance instruction-level parallelism and reduce dependency hazards, thereby facilitating rather than obstructing aggressive pipelining in an integer unit.

questions.stem_text: The maximum possible degree of the minimal-degree interpolating polynomial p(x) for n + 1 distinct points is n + 1.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is False because the maximum degree of the minimal-degree interpolating polynomial for n + 1 distinct points is n, not n + 1, as a polynomial of degree n can uniquely interpolate n + 1 points if they are not all on the same polynomial of degree less than n.

questions.stem_text: The number of distinct functions mapping a finite set A with m elements into a finite set B with n elements is n!/(n - m)!
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is false because the number of distinct functions from a set A with m elements to a set B with n elements is actually n^m, not n!/(n - m)!, as each element in A can be independently mapped to any of the n elements in B.

questions.stem_text: A digital signature can be effectively created using a shared-key system without the need for public-key infrastructure.
questions.answer_explanation: A digital signature relies on asymmetric cryptography, which requires a public-private key pair, making it incompatible with a shared-key system that uses symmetric cryptography.
